title: 💻 Llama.cpp and Vulkan backend compatibility issue

messages.content: I am building llama.cpp with Vulkan backend. When I try to run it, it fails because it requires 16bit storage, however that is not supported by my Vulkan device. Is there an option to switch to 32bit storage?
